title: Hot Take: How the Knicks celebrated their long-awaited championship in the offs…
author: Rico
summary: ESPN's "How the Knicks celebrated their long-awaited championship in the offseason" is the headline, and you already know where this is going. J.J. Post and Kalan Hooks get the byline on what amounts to a glossy recap of every champagne-soaked moment from June through September—Jalen Brunson hosting Saturday Night Live, KAT getting married, the whole beautiful domino effect that happens when a franchise finally breaks through. And sure, it all started with one very real event: a Knicks title. But Rico has thoughts, and they mostly involve the word "premature."

content.value:
## The Headline

ESPN — J.J. Post and Kalan Hooks: **"How the Knicks celebrated their long-awaited championship in the offseason"**

Oh good, we're already writing the celebration pieces. Nothing says "tempting fate" quite like a splashy offseason victory-lap feature when the season hasn't even started yet. Look, I get it—the Knicks won, the city went nuts, everyone had a beautiful summer. But this is exactly the kind of headline that reads one way in October and a completely different way come April, when the defending champs are getting bounced in the second round and we're all pretending we didn't see this coming. Here's the read right now, before anyone's kept score.
